{{Quote|They're mine!''"<br />"''The Eodon! Yours. Enjoy those!|The Ewoks return the tusks to their proper owner|<ref name="HS" />}}
An '''Eodon''' was living on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. At some point, the Eodon its tusks, and they ended up in the possession of a [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] named [[Mooth]] who operated a [[Mooth's trading post|trading post]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]]. The Eodon eventually traveled to Mooth's place, where the toothless creature discovered that the tusks were now in the possession of four young [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]]&mdash;[[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]], [[Latara/Legends|Latara]], [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]], and [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]]. The Eodon demanded the tusks back, and the Ewoks complied.<ref name="HS" />

==Behind the scenes==
This Eodon was created by writer [[Michael Reaves]] for "[[Hard Sell]]," an episode of the [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']] animated series that first aired on October 25, [[1986]], during the show's second season.<ref name="A Star Wars CELibration">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}.</ref> The unidentified Eodon is played by an uncredited voice actor.
